name: hud_ui_text_input_shift_text_left
description: HudUiTextInput::ShiftTextLeft shifts bytes left by count from startPos through the current text length and returns success.
known_limits: tier S verification remains deferred to the HudUiTextInput class/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4b45e0 validates inline strlen via repne scasb, then for index from startPos while index < strlen(buffer) copies buffer[index + count] into buffer[index] and returns 1.
Native smoke zhud_text_input_constructor_and_alloc_smoke exercises ShiftTextLeft through BackspaceDeleteChar restoring 'abXcd' to 'abcd' and through DeleteCharForward changing 'abcd' to 'abd'.
